name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Chicken Katsu Don (Simmered Cutlet & Egg over Rice)
whyItWorks: Tender chicken cutlet simmered in sweet dashi broth with beaten eggs until soft, served over hot steamed white sticky rice. The simmering softens the breading.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken Katsu Don with extra white rice (hold sliced onions if sensitive to cooked alliums).
